reviews.comment: Dr. Sentmanat was an amazing professor, he has excellent notes and teaches concepts extremely well. He is able to make hard concepts such as Navier Stokes clear and understandable. Amazing professor and he is very caring and practical, recording lectures on Zoom and prepares you well for exam.

Absolutely amazing professor. The most organized notes of all time, and you can use his notes on the exam. Lectures and recitation were very helpful in learning the content, and the homework was similar to exam problems. Graduate late to take his class, it was phenomenal.

Dr. Sentmanat is a national treasure. His lectures are amazing and very interesting. As a student, trust that he will do his job and make the class fair. You will do well on his exams, but you must give a solid effort even if you don't understand how to do the problems. He wants you to succeed. Exam averages were around 83-90 for us.

Dr. Sentmanat is the GOAT. Hands down one of the best CHEN profs. Very nice and caring guy and a very lenient grader when it comes to exams. As others have said, he has the most beautiful lecture notes and posts them after class. Daily quiz each class so show up to class. Open note exams were difficult but very fair. TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN!!!!!

He's the goat what can i say. The best CHEN prof. Amazing lectures and all you need are his beautiful, scrumptious gorgeous notes. He is a caring professor who wants you to be a great chemical engineer. Tests are fair but expect to work hard.

Best CHEN prof I have had so far! Very funny and engaging in lectures. Has very clear notes, and posts recordings of lectures, recitations and working through homeworks. He is a very lenient grader on exams, but they are pretty tough. Overall super nice guy and amazing to learn from! Take if you can for any class!

Dr. Sentmanat was a fantastic professor. His lectures holistically covered the course material and emphasized the topics in fluid mechanics that would be applicable in industry. Exams and homeworks were fairly graded. He is very accessible outside of class and very accommodating to student needs.

Prof. Sentmanat is the best lecturer that I have had so far, what he does that is so different from other professors is emphasize the basics. His exams are fair, and are a challenge, but if you understand the homework and recitation questions, especially the reasoning behind why certain equations are used and how a procedure is chosen.

Incredible professor. Detailed lectures that he records and posts after. Weekly homework is tough but prepares you well for exams. Easy participation quizzes in class, so attend lectures. Exams are very similar to homework's, and he doesn't try to trick you. Overall, Sentmanat really cares for his students and teaches the material well.

Gives tons of resources, exams are open note/open homework, exam problems are easier versions of homework problems, extremely straightforward what will be on exam and what won't. If you sit down and do and understand the homework you will do well. Homework probably 2-5 hours a week depending on the week. Actually felt like I've learned something.

AMAZING PROF! His lectures were amazing and super interesting. Plus, the group projects were really fun to work on! The midterm exam is super easy to prepare for. I would highly advise you to take this course as it contains a lot of really interesting knowledge that you can use!

CHEN 489 during Fall Semester. Prof S lectures well. There are daily in-class quizzes so definitely attend all lectures. There is a vegetable fermentation project with a report. There is an alcoholic fermentation project with a report and presentation. These are chill. There is an open-note midterm exam. Really enjoyed the course. Very low stress!

Dr. Sentmanat was a fantastic professor. His lecture notes and explanations of problems were extremely clear. Exams were open note and pretty challenging, but overall I would definitely take him again. He also has a lot of industry experience and is very approachable.
Dr. Sentmanat is the GOAT! He is super easy to re

Probably the best prof I've had in college. Class set up can keep you engaged, he also knows how to explain difficult concepts and answer questions. Exams and homeworks are difficult, but he gives a lot of partial credit. Does a great job keeping interest and enjoyment high in such a difficult class.

Dr. Sentmanat is a great professor. He is clear about what concepts you need to know for the exam, and he prepares you well for it. Homework and in class examples are excellent references to have when taking the open-note exam. You just need to know how changes affect the problem. I highly recommend Dr. Sentmanat for a good fluid ops experience.

Fluids isn't an easy class but he definitely was the best choice. He's very passionate about the material and does his best to communicate what can be some pretty boring content. Very friendly as well, he just has a lot of very positive energy that makes the class bearable. Daily quizzes, but they're pretty easy. HW can take a while.

Excellent professor. Dr. Sentmanat is very friendly and engaging and actively wants his classes to learn. Exams were slightly challenging, but his lecture style and notes are very informative. Would take again for sure.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: friendly and caring, has PhD but also worked in industry so interesting perspective, teaches similar to ugaz, I read the book some&helped for hw but you'll learn better by going to class and office hours for questions, wants you to succeed and if you put in some work (not an unreasonable amount) you can get an A *we switched online 1/2way thru
